ValidationRule.description: Ensures the rating is entered using a standardized 1 to 5 scale to maintain consistent scoring across feedback records.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Written_Communication__c)), OR(Written_Communication__c < 1, Written_Communication__c > 5)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Verbal_Communication__c)), OR(Verbal_Communication__c < 1, Verbal_Communication__c > 5)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Technical_Skills__c)), OR(Technical_Skills__c < 1, Technical_Skills__c > 5)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Time_Management__c)), OR(Time_Management__c < 1, Time_Management__c > 5)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Client_Satisfaction__c)), OR(Client_Satisfaction__c < 1, Client_Satisfaction__c > 5)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Rating must be a whole number between 1 and 5.
